content.text:
UNDP works with partners in developing countries to advance sustainable and low-carbon energy transition. This work is anchored by its Strategic Plan 2022-2025.

Energy – along with poverty and inequality, governance, resilience, environment, and gender equality – are among the six signature solutions of the Strategic Plan. Together, the signature solutions represent UNDP’s vision to accelerate progress on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

This chapter provides more details on UNDP's Sustainable Energy Academy initiative.
